_about: Hand-entered deck constants for make_deck.py --depth 100. Fill every null from the depth-100 trees after the rerun; make_deck refuses to build while any is null. Depth-20 values (make_deck.py SELF_TOP20/SELF_SAT/SELF_CRED/EMPTIED) are given under _depth20 for reference only.

_how.SELF_TOP20: % of amplicons (include mode, one row per amplicon) whose source genome is in its own record: asv_region_concordance.csv column self_in_top20 (now = in the top 100), as the ad hoc si.py computed it; per panel tree region_validation{,_kmeans,_random}_d100[_legacy]/data NOTE: the asv_region_concordance column also matches on taxon and gives the higher genome-or-taxon share; the deck uses genome-only membership.
_how.SELF_SAT: % of amplicons where the source is NOT in the record and the whole record is one exact tie (tie saturation); SELF_TOP20 + SELF_SAT + SELF_CRED = 100
_how.SELF_CRED: % of amplicons where the source is NOT in the record and the source's sequence (md5) is credited to another genome
_how.EMPTIED: % of full-length, tau=0.987 exclude-mode organisms whose whole record is removed by self-exclusion: three_panel/emptied_strata.py --suffix _d100[_legacy], field emptied_pct

_filled: 2026-10-27 from the depth-100 trees: SELF_* per amplicon from each panel's hits records (genome-only membership; 99.06/73.85/68.00, 0.94/8.19/15.08, 0.00/17.96/16.92 before rounding, so k-means sums to 100.1 after rounding); EMPTIED from three_panel/emptied_strata_d100*.json (4.66/22.90/33.39, identical under both rules). Verified in region_validation_d100/D100_VS_D20.md section 5.
